recent.text: On November 26, 2016, Jeff Carter scored his 70th career game-winning goal in a 2-1 overtime win over Chicago. Carter ranks fifth in @LAKings' history with 44 game-winning goals, and is tied with Adrian Kempe for the franchise record for overtime goals (11). #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/MXRkKruzdj
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 26, 2009, the @LAKings signed top prospect Brayden Schenn to a one-day tryout. Schenn, who was selected fifth overall in 2009, made his NHL debut that night against the Vancouver Canucks and became the third youngest player to debut with the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/THrhKQ9yyG

recent.text: On November 26, 2002, the @LAKings acquired defenseman Dmitry Yushkevich and a fifth round pick (Brady Murray) from the Florida Panthers for Jaroslav Bednar and Andreas Lilja. Yushkevich recorded three assists and 24 penalty minutes in 42 games with the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/F5owTOuSwY

recent.text: On November 26, 1991, filming for Lethal Weapon 3 took place at the Great Western Forum during a home game between the @LAKings and Maple Leafs. Tomas Sandstrom, Wayne Gretzky, Tony Granato, and Luc Robitaille scored for the #LAKings in a 4-4 tie versus Toronto. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/qE8mBbHczT
